description: Every Woolworths catalogue, specials, store and trolley surface, plus a local price history that can tell a genuine half-price from an inflated was-price.

tools.name: categories_browse
tools.description: Browse or page one category or specials group by node id. Required: category-id. Optional: page (default: 1), page-size (default: 24), sort (default: TraderRelevance) (plus 3 more).

params.name: category-id
params.description: Node id, e.g. specialsgroup.3676 (Half Price) or a department node

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number

params.name: page-size
params.description: Results per page; Woolworths hard-caps this at 36

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order; CUPAsc/CUPDesc sort by unit price server-side

params.name: specials-only
params.description: Restrict to products currently on special

params.name: url
params.description: Browse path the request is attributed to; required by the API, affects only response SEO metadata

params.name: format-object
params.description: JSON blob the API requires alongside url; affects only response SEO metadata

tools.name: categories_list
tools.description: Full department tree including the five specials groups and their product counts. Returns array.

tools.name: products_batch
tools.description: Fetch several products in one call by comma-separated stockcodes. Required: stockcodes.

params.name: stockcodes
params.description: Comma-separated stockcodes, e.g. 6073909,36066

tools.name: products_count
tools.description: Cheap result counts for a term - products, specials, recipes - without fetching tiles. Required: term.

params.name: term
params.description: Search term to count matches for

tools.name: products_detail
tools.description: Full product record including nutrition, variants and country of origin. Required: stockcode.

params.name: stockcode
params.description: Woolworths stockcode, e.g. 6073909

tools.name: products_schemaorg
tools.description: Product as schema.org JSON-LD; an independent path from products detail. Required: stockcode.

params.name: stockcode
params.description: Woolworths stockcode, e.g. 6073909

tools.name: products_search
tools.description: Search products by term, with optional specials-only filter and sort. Required: term. Optional: page (default: 1), page-size (default: 24), sort (default: TraderRelevance) (plus 1 more).

params.name: term
params.description: Search term, e.g. 'tim tam' or 'olive oil'

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number

params.name: page-size
params.description: Results per page; Woolworths hard-caps this at 36

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order; CUPAsc/CUPDesc sort by unit price server-side

params.name: specials-only
params.description: Restrict results to products currently on special

tools.name: products_suggestions
tools.description: Ranked search suggestions and autocorrect for a partial term. Required: term.

params.name: term
params.description: Partial search term, e.g. 'mil'

tools.name: settings_bootstrap
tools.description: App bootstrap config including current site version.

tools.name: stores_list
tools.description: Find stores near a postcode or coordinate, with trading hours and facilities. Optional: postcode, latitude, longitude (plus 2 more).

params.name: postcode
params.description: Australian postcode to search near, e.g. 2000. Supply this or latitude+longitude

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude to search near, e.g. -33.8688. Use with --longitude instead of --postcode

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude to search near, e.g. 151.2093. Use with --latitude instead of --postcode

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum stores to return

params.name: division
params.description: Comma-separated divisions, e.g. SUPERMARKETS,EG,AMPOL. Optional filter; not a substitute for a location

tools.name: trolley_add
tools.description: Add a product to the trolley by stockcode. Required: stock-code. Optional: quantity (default: 1), source (default: Search).

params.name: stock-code
params.description: Stockcode of the product to add

params.name: quantity
params.description: Quantity to add

params.name: source
params.description: Origin hint Woolworths records for the add, e.g. Search

novel_features.name: Genuine-special verdict
novel_features.description: Tells you whether an advertised special is genuinely cheap or just a lower number next to an inflated was-price.

novel_features.name: Half-price cycle forecast
novel_features.description: Estimates when a product's next half-price window is likely to open, from its own recorded discount episodes.

novel_features.name: Cheaper substitute finder
novel_features.description: Ranks in-stock alternatives by unit price normalised across different measure bases, so per-100g and per-1kg tiles compare correctly.

novel_features.name: Basket costing from a list
novel_features.description: Prices a whole shopping list, showing which lines moved since the last time you ran it and what it did to the total.

novel_features.name: Specials rollover diff
novel_features.description: Shows what entered and left each specials group since your last sync, with how long since each entrant was last discounted.

novel_features.name: Multi-buy effective unit price
novel_features.description: Works out what a multi-buy offer actually costs per unit at the quantity it demands, versus buying singly or buying a larger pack.
